headline: Ethereum Developers Delay Glamsterdam Test Over Smart Contract Risks
summary: Developers canceled the Hoodi network activation for the Glamsterdam test after researchers demonstrated how new gas rules could permanently record failed operations.
why: Ethereum is the leading decentralized smart contract blockchain platform, and protocol upgrades require rigorous security testing to protect existing decentralized applications.

impacts.name: Ethereum
impacts.why: Delays in testnet upgrades highlight technical caution in maintaining network stability for smart contracts.
